title: Short context menu on scene tab, after focusing floating script editor
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: v4.7.rc2.official [3df26a02c] v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4] ### System information Godot v4.7.rc2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Right-clicking on a scene tab after focusing a floating script editor, shows the same short menu as when right-clicking on an empty spot on the scene tab bar. Maybe the right-click passes through the scene tab to the scene tab bar. ### Steps to reproduce - create a new project - unmaximize Godot and shrink it's window size to keep the scene tab ([empty]) visible while another window is focused outside Godot - switch to the script editor - in the script editors top right corner, click: make the script editor floating - drag the floating script editor outside Godot, keeping the scene tab bar visible for example: ``` _________________ ________|Script editor | |Godot | | | ----------------- | | ------------ ``` - focus the script editor - right-click on Godot's only scene tab: [empty] ### Issue The short right-click menu appears. 4 entries: > new scene > save all scenes > undo close tab > close all tabs https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ed1ca676-a273-48d1-8287-e06a813fe2cf To show the long right-click menu: - close the right-click menu (esc or left or right click away from the menu) - right-click on the scene tab again This requires extra steps when saving a scene tab after using the floating script editor. ### Expected Show the long right-click menu. 12 entries: > new scene > save scene > save scene as > save all scenes > show in filesystem > play this scene > set as main scene > close tabs > undo close tab > close other tabs > close tabs to the right > close all tabs ### A possible cause Maybe the mouse click passes through the scene tab to the tab bar behind it. Notes: It isn't as simple as when Godot is unfocused, because it only happens when the floating script editor was the last focused Godot window before right-clicking on a scene tab. Issue: - focus floating script editor, right-click on a scene tab - focus floating script editor, focus another app or the win 11 desktop, right-click on a scene tab Expected: - with Godot's main window focused, right-click on a scene tab - with Godot's main window focused, focus another app or the win 11 desktop, right-click on a scene tab There's a related open issue about Godot 3. Problem with scene tabs https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/86068 But Godot 3 doesn't have a floating script editor button. In Godot v3.6.2.stable.official [3cd3caab6] the issue occurs when: - Godot is unfocused, right-click on a scene tab - Godot is focused, a right-click menu is open, right-click on a scene tab None of them are reproducible in Godot 4, because right-clicking closes an open menu. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
